description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of matches across six distinct categories, labeled numerically from 0 to 5, likely indicating different levels or outcomes. The third largest, a pale yellow, is "1 Match" at 13.8% (4046). The fourth largest, a cream color, is "0 Matches" at 13.3% (3910). The fifth slice, a light blue, is "5 Matches" at 10.4% (3043). The smallest slice, a muted green, is "3 Matches" at 6.8% (2002). The sixth and final slice, also light blue, is "4 Matches" at 6.2% (1810). Each slice contains its percentage and count in parentheses, and the category label is positioned outside the chart. The slices appear to be arranged in descending order of size, starting from the largest at the top left and proceeding clockwise. There is no legend, and no slices are visually emphasized beyond their proportional size.
